name: measureReal_abs_dual_gt_le_integral_charFunDual
statement: Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [OpensMeasurableSpace E] {μ : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (L : StrongDual ℝ E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : μ.real {x | r < |L x|} ≤ 2⁻¹ * r * ‖∫ t in -2 * r⁻¹..2 * r⁻¹, 1 - charFunDual μ (t • L)‖
